summary.text: Jim Harrison, a Republican from Chittenden, represented Rutland-11 in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2017 until he resigned on January 6, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Harrison is the former president of the Vermont Retail & Grocers Association, a position he held until the end of 2016 after a career of more than 29 years with the organization, according to his House biography.
He has a BS from Cornell University and an MBA from New Hampshire College.
His biography says he served as treasurer of the Friends of the Chittenden Public Library and was a member of the Chittenden Historical Society.
He and his wife, Pat, have lived in North Chittenden since 2006 and have two adult children and five grandsons.
